rows.grounds: fused pararūpam + tu; accusative neuter singular of pararūpa plus enclitic tu
dative singular of sādhanasiddhi, 'success of accomplishment'

items.question: What other form must be accomplished for success of accomplishment?
premises: the practitioner accomplishes the other form
the other form is the to-be-accomplished
accomplishment aims at success of accomplishment
items.inference: The verse directs accomplishing the other form of the to-be-accomplished for success of accomplishment.
uncertainties: exact referent of pararūpa in this ritual context is not specified by the verse alone
items.plain_english: One should accomplish the other form, the to-be-accomplished, for success of accomplishment.
